title: Secret Strategies — Design
summary: Design for assigning each screensaver NetHack game one of four secret bot strategies, each aimed at a different ending, with milestones, config, reveal, and tests.
notes: Path under docs/superpowers/specs/ gives a SPEC signal. Content is mixed: it has a Decisions table and an Acceptance section (PRD-like), but its substance is implementation contracts (milestone plans, data flow, GameResult fields, config keys, test plan), so SPEC was chosen. Status reads 'Approved design, pending spec review', not an ADR status, so locked is false. No ADR Context/Consequences sections. No other doc paths are referenced; code identifiers and scripts/benchmark.py are not doc cross-refs. Hash suffix is a placeholder: the classifier had no shell to compute SHA-256 of the source path, so the filename must be renamed with the first 8 hex chars of sha256 of the POSIX source path.
